In detail

Avon and Somerset Constabulary recorded 203 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 10.2 per 1,000 residents, the 4th highest rate of Bath's 33 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (10), vehicle crime (3), drugs (1); the evening/night score by violent crime (23), anti social behaviour (19), public order (2). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Keynsham North safe?

Wandroz currently rates Keynsham North in Bath as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bath during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bath at night. This rating is derived from Avon and Somerset Constabulary street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Keynsham North safe at night?

At night, Keynsham North is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bath. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Keynsham North a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Keynsham North's day rating (roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bath) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
